d:
For more than four hours on Friday, no flight could take off anywhere in the United States. The Federal Aviation Administration ordered a rare nationwide ground stop after a telecommunications failure hit all of the country's Air Route Traffic Control Centers, leading to thousands of cancellations and stranding hundreds of thousands of travelers. Reports point to a network run by defense contractor L3Harris Technologies.
So what went wrong, what exactly is L3Harris, and why is America's air traffic control still relying on a network built more than two decades ago?
